servers.description: An AI-agent-first framework for building MCP servers that deliver interactive React widgets directly within AI chat interfaces like ChatGPT and Claude. It includes automated visual testing and a zero-config local development environment designed for autonomous agent workflows.

BASE_URL.description: The base URL where the widget assets are hosted (e.g., https://your-domain.com/assets). The server replaces placeholders at runtime with this value. Essential for remote or VPS deployments.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Your OpenAI API key. Required for 'Full Mode' in the app tester to use specific models; otherwise, the tester defaults to Puter.js (Zero-Config Mode).

servers.name: MCP App Template

servers.description: A production-grade server for programmatically controlling kitty terminal instances, allowing users to launch windows, send text or key combinations, and capture scrollback buffer content. It facilitates automation workflows and command analysis by providing remote control over the kitty terminal through the Model Context Protocol.
servers.name: Kitty MCP Server

servers.description: A lightweight MCP server that provides persistent key-value storage for AI agents using SQLite and Bun. It enables agents to store, retrieve, and manage memories with optional JSON metadata for long-term context retention.

MEMORY_DB_PATH.description: Path to the SQLite database file

servers.name: Memory MCP Server

servers.description: Connects AI coding assistants to Gaffer test history and coverage data to analyze project health, debug failures, and identify untested code areas. It enables tools to track test stability, cluster failures by root cause, and monitor code coverage trends across projects.

GAFFER_API_KEY.description: Your Gaffer API Key (starts with gaf_)

servers.name: Gaffer MCP Server

servers.description: Enables image generation and multi-turn editing sessions using the Gemini API within MCP-compatible environments. Users can create, modify, and configure images through natural language commands, supporting features like aspect ratio adjustments and session-based image transformations.

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: The API key for the Gemini API used for image generation and editing.

servers.name: Gemini Image MCP

servers.description: A locally-hosted MCP server that integrates Gmail, Google Calendar, and Google Drive to provide AI-powered management of emails, events, and files. It enables tool-based interactions like sending emails, creating calendar events, and searching Drive files through clients like Cursor and Claude Desktop.
servers.name: Google MCP Server

servers.description: A token-efficient MCP server for exploring GitHub repositories using tree-sitter AST parsing to extract symbol signatures and summaries. It enables users to search and retrieve specific code components while significantly reducing token consumption compared to raw file dumps.
servers.name: github-codemunch-mcp

servers.description: An MCP server for building, validating, and publishing Ice Puzzle levels with AI assistants, featuring integrated solver feedback and quality checks. It provides over 60 tools for level design, difficulty analysis, and benchmarking AI performance on design tasks.

ICE_PUZZLE_PROJECT_ID.description: The project ID for the Firebase instance. Defaults to 'ice-puzzle-game'.

ICE_PUZZLE_FIREBASE_MESSAGING_SENDER_ID.description: Explicit Firebase Messaging sender ID override.

servers.name: ice-puzzle-mcp

servers.description: An MCP server for restaurant discovery and booking across Resy and OpenTable via natural language. It integrates Google Places data with dietary preferences, visit history, and weather awareness to provide personalized dining recommendations and group reservation management.

RESTAURANT_MCP_KEY.description: Master key generated during setup that replaces individual API keys and credentials by encrypting them in the local database.

servers.name: Maître d'MCP

servers.description: A Model Context Protocol server built with FastMCP that enables dynamic tool loading and configuration from individual Python files. It provides a flexible framework for automatically discovering, testing, and running tools via Stdio or HTTP transport modes.

DATABASE_URL.description: The connection string for the database tool example.

WEATHER_API_KEY.description: The API key for the weather tool (used by the OpenWeatherMap API example).

MCP_TRANSPORT_MODE.description: The transport mode for the server. Set to 'http' to use HTTP mode with WebSocket MCP endpoint; otherwise defaults to stdio.

servers.name: my-mcp-server

servers.description: Enables AI models to interact with Discord using human-readable channel names and usernames through smart target resolution and automatic mention processing. It provides tools for sending messages, reading channel history, and searching for content without requiring manual snowflake ID lookups.

DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Your Discord bot token. Obtain this from the Discord Developer Portal.

servers.name: Discord MCP Server

servers.description: Enables AI assistants to read, write, and format Google Spreadsheets through the Model Context Protocol. It supports comprehensive operations including data retrieval, sheet creation, and cell formatting using natural language commands.
servers.name: Spreadsheet MCP Server

servers.description: Enables domain name availability checking through DNS and WHOIS lookups with confidence scoring. It supports searching across alternative TLDs and generating domain name variations for branding purposes.
servers.name: domain-mcp

servers.description: Enables AI assistants to manage Fusebase workspaces by providing 46 tools for handling pages, tasks, folders, and organizational administration. It features a two-tier tool system and secure session management using reverse-engineered internal endpoints.

FUSEBASE_TOOLS.description: Set to 'all' to enable extended tools (28 additional tools) beyond the core 18.

FUSEBASE_COOKIE.description: Optionally pass session cookies directly if the encrypted local store (data/cookie.enc) isn't available.

FUSEBASE_ORG_ID.description: Your organization ID, found in the Fusebase URL or API responses.

servers.name: Fusebase MCP Server

servers.description: Enables users to extract, search, and analyze YouTube video transcripts directly within MCP-compatible clients. It supports advanced features like time-chunked summaries, keyword searching with surrounding context, and batch processing for multiple videos.

YT_MCP_MODE.description: Operating mode: 'standalone' (uses youtube-transcript-api directly) or 'backend' (connects to a running transcript service).

YT_MCP_BACKEND_URL.description: Backend service URL, used when YT_MCP_MODE is set to 'backend'.

YT_MCP_CACHE_MAX_SIZE.description: Maximum number of entries allowed in the cache.

YT_MCP_BACKEND_API_KEY.description: API key for backend, used when YT_MCP_MODE is set to 'backend'.

YT_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE.description: Maximum number of requests allowed per minute.

servers.name: YouTube Transcript MCP Server

servers.description: Mob is an AI-first personal CRM that enables users to manage contacts, relationships, and activities entirely through natural language via the Model Context Protocol. It allows for tracking life events, reminders, and notes using a local SQLite database or an ephemeral session mode.

MOB_DATA_DIR.description: The directory for SQLite database storage. Ensure this directory is on persistent storage to retain data across restarts.

servers.name: Mob

servers.description: An MCP server that enables AI agents to read, create, and modify Google Spreadsheets through actions like editing cells and managing sheets. It features a specialized handoff protocol to synchronize tasks and state between different LLMs using a shared spreadsheet log.
servers.name: Google Sheets MCP

servers.description: Connects AI assistants to Warpmetrics telemetry data to monitor AI agent performance, execution runs, and LLM costs. It allows users to query success rates, latency, and spend metrics directly through natural language interfaces.
servers.name: Warpmetrics MCP Server

servers.description: PhysBound is a specialized "Physics Linter" for AI that deterministically validates RF and thermodynamic claims against hard physical limits, preventing hallucinations in engineering workflows.
servers.name: physbound
